root:
usage: mem [-h] [--human] [--server SERVER] [--version]
           {login,logout,init,status,flush,projects,manifest,device,ls,read,devices,add,pointer,rm,mv,search,index,hook}
           ...

stateless project memory

positional arguments:
  {login,logout,init,status,flush,projects,manifest,device,ls,read,devices,add,pointer,rm,mv,search,index,hook}
    login               enroll this device
    logout              delete the local token
    init                create a project and write .mem.toml
    status              server-side status
    flush               wait for accepted writes and text indexing
    projects            list projects
    manifest            list files under a topic
    device              manage this device's private home
    ls                  list notes
    read                read one or more notes
    devices             list or retire devices
    add                 write and version files in one atomic commit
    pointer             manage explicit pointer references
    rm                  remove and version one note (one atomic act)
    mv                  atomically move a record or topic
    search              server-side text search
    index               inspect or rebuild the search index
    hook                follow a git repository's commits into memory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --human               human-readable output
  --server SERVER       override the server URL
  --version             show program's version number and exit

positional arguments:

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --human               human-readable output
  --server SERVER       override the server URL

                        bytes

  --from-git REV        take the content from REV (as committed) instead of
                        the working tree
  -m MESSAGE, --message MESSAGE
                        describe this change (default: derived)

                {add,rm,ls,init,update,check} ...

positional arguments:
  {add,rm,ls,init,update,check}
    add                 declare path globs to follow
    rm                  stop following path globs
    ls                  show patterns, hook state, watermark
    init                install pre-commit validation and post-commit sync
                        hooks
    update              capture committed changes since the last capture (also
                        run by the hook)
    check               validate staged, hook-selected Markdown locally

  --human               human-readable output
  --server SERVER       override the server URL
